platform_constraints: Tauri Webview: WebGPU is available but must be enabled in Tauri config.
Android Webview: Hardware acceleration is inconsistent; WebGL2 is the reliable fallback for high-end ASCII rendering.
Resource Lifecycle: Tauri does not automatically manage JS/Canvas memory; explicit cleanup is required to prevent the 'glitch' (overlap/state bleed).

exact_code_recipes.how_to_wire: Call on app init. Returns a tier object. Pass the 'device' from TIER_2 to compute shaders or the 'gl' context to fragment shaders.
Each video/image in your UI gets its own MediaWorkspace instance. When switching workspaces, call .destroy() on the old one before initializing the new one.
Wrap sidebars and status bars in a '.hide-in-zen' class. Toggle the 'is-zen' class on the root container when the top-right button is clicked.

anti_hallucination_guidance: BANNED: Do not use a simple CSS 'opacity: 0' for workspace switching; it causes the 'glitch' of overlapping video. Use OffscreenCanvas transfer.
BANNED: Do not fake hardware detection with a random number generator. Use the navigator.gpu and WEBGL_debug_renderer_info APIs.
BANNED: Do not use complex state management for Zen mode; a single boolean and a root-level CSS class is the proven Excalidraw pattern.
